name: Ithamar
bio: Ithamar is Aaron's fourth son, who became one of Aaron's two surviving sons after his elder brothers Nadab and Abihu were struck down by God for offering strange fire (Leviticus 10:6, 12). Moses was once angry at Ithamar and his brother Eleazar for not eating the sin offering meat in the holy place as instructed; Aaron explained the circumstances of that difficult day, and Moses was satisfied (Leviticus 10:16-20). Ithamar's descendants later became an important priestly division within the tribe of Levi during King David's reign, as recorded in 1 Chronicles.
